messages:
devon: Hey team — planning a phased return from parental leave starting 2026-06-15. I want 3 weeks at 60% then 2 weeks at 80% before returning full time. Also need to travel to Amsterdam for ~10 days during that ramp for our kid's school enrollment. What forms do I need and how will pay/benefits be handled?

anya (People Ops): Congrats! Please file the Phased Return form in the HR portal under Leaves & Return. Add your detailed weekly schedule and travel dates in the form. Also fill the Remote Work Abroad mini-form so we can assess any tax/security implications.

devon: Where's the Phased Return form in the portal?

anya (People Ops): Top nav -> "Leaves & Return" -> "Phased Return / Reduced Schedule". If helpful, copy this template to your manager for approval:

```
Hi @sarah — requesting phased return starting 2026-06-15: weeks 1-3 at 60% (Mon/Wed full, Tue/Thu half), weeks 4-5 at 80% (4 days/week). Traveling to Amsterdam 2026-06-20 to 2026-06-30; will work remotely during reduced hours. Requesting approval for schedule and any necessary coverage adjustments.
```

sarah: Sounds reasonable. Please propose coverage for on-call and key deliverables in the calendar; I'll sign off once People Ops confirms payroll/proration.

payroll-bot: Note: use payroll code PARENT_PHASE for reduced schedule. PTO accrual is prorated to scheduled FTE during the phased period. Benefit premiums remain unchanged for up to 12 weeks of phased return for US-based employees. Bonus and eligibility elements may pro-rate per compensation policy.

devon: The Amsterdam trip is under 30 days, so tax residency shouldn't be triggered, right?

security-bot: Reminder: any cross-border remote work requires manager approval plus People Ops sign-off. For EU access, we need Security review for data residency and VPN access. Please add location and device details to the Remote Work Abroad form.

anya (People Ops): Also, you may be eligible for the Family Support Stipend up to $900 during the phased ramp for childcare/schooling receipts. It's not automatic; submit receipts within 30 days after the phased period ends. Eligibility: active FT headcount at leave start and approved phased return.

amir (Finance): For clarity: stipend disbursed after receipts review. Payroll will pro-rate salary for days/hours not worked. If you change your FTE within the phased return, let payroll know ASAP to avoid miscalculations.

devon: Is there a deadline to submit the phased-return form?

anya (People Ops): Submit at least 2 weeks before your intended return date to allow approvals and payroll changes. Since you're aiming for 2026-06-15, please submit today or this week.

sarah: I'll block 30 minutes next Tue for a quick sync with you @devon to finalize handoffs.

devon: Will do — submitting forms now. Thanks! :thumbsup:

anya (People Ops): Thanks — tag me after you submit and I'll fast-track the review. If Security or Finance need extra info, we'll loop them here. (reaction :eyes:)
